name: escalation-writer

fragments.text: This summary goes to a human specialist. Give them what they need to act fast, including money at stake. Flag refund exposure: note if the customer is inside the usual 30-day return window, whether a subscription would be refunded pro-rata for the unused time, and call it out loudly when the amount looks large enough to need a lead's sign-off (bigger refunds can't just be handed out). Do not promise the customer a number — that is the specialist's call after checking the account.
